title: Record experiment results as supported, unsupported or inconclusive
summary: Extend the Dionysus experiment module in athena-core with a Result enum (supported, unsupported, inconclusive) and a function that records one on a validated, concluded experiment. Then set OLY-R6-02's mechanism and measure in docs/spec.toml, ending the measure with `status: not shown` and the test name.

defaults_applied.how: New unit tests in exploration.rs; fmt, clippy and test criteria.
Criterion runs the tests that record each result.
One module and one spec entry.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/exploration.rs (Experiment, Outcome, validate, conclude; only users of Experiment in crates/) and crates/athena-core/src/status.rs STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS. No label there shows experiment results, so the measure is `status: not shown` plus the test, as the request allows; adding a status line is out of scope.
No new record or data file is added under crates/, so check_record_file, AnyRecord and the round-trip test do not apply; the result is an in-memory field on Experiment, with no persistence.
No refusal rule is tightened for readings; the only new refusal applies to experiments, which nothing outside exploration.rs constructs.
Goal: Athena's owner and the verifier can see that an experiment result is one of three values; audience is spec reviewers running cargo test.
Existing code: crates/athena-core/src/exploration.rs and docs/spec.toml are extended, not created.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/spec.toml OLY-R6-02 has a mechanism naming exploration.rs and its result-recording function (not "none"), keeps owner "Athena", and has a measure ending `status: not shown` that names the exploration test via `cargo test -p athena-core exploration`.
crates/athena-core/src/exploration.rs defines a result type with exactly the variants Supported, Unsupported and Inconclusive and a function that stores one on an Experiment (Grep shows both).

Run `cargo test -p athena-core exploration`: new tests show a concluded experiment records each of the three results and reads them back, and an invalid (e.g. unbounded) or not-yet-concluded experiment refuses a result with a Refusal. The tests fail to compile or fail if the recording function is removed.
Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo test` (including the xtask spec test): all pass, with no other spec.toml requirement changed.

out_of_scope: Adding a new `athena status` line or STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS entry
Changes to other spec requirements, athena.toml, defaults.toml or workflows
